mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_agents a JOIN nw_agent_publications p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.agent_id=a.id AND p.id=a.published_revision_id WHERE a.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND a.id::text=#{agent} AND a.status='published' AND p.snapshot #> '{agent,config,memory,automatic_extraction}'='true'::jsonb)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_group_memory_extraction_policies(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,enabled,extractor_agent_id,revision,updated_by_principal) VALUES(CAST(#{row.tenantId} AS bigint),#{row.integrationId},CAST(#{row.groupBindingId} AS bigint),#{row.enabled}, CAST(#{row.extractorAgentId} AS bigint),#{row.revision},#{row.updatedByPrincipal}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled=excluded.enabled, extractor_agent_id=excluded.extractor_agent_id,revision=excluded.revision,updated_by_principal=excluded.updated_by_principal, updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE nw_group_memory_extraction_policies.revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT p.tenant_id::text AS tenant_id,p.integration_id,p.group_binding_id::text AS group_binding_id, s.session_id,p.source_message_id,p.source_sequence,s.source_revision,s.author_end_user_id, c.extractor_agent_id::text AS agent_id FROM nw_group_memory_extraction_pending p JOIN nw_group_source_messages s USING(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,source_message_id,source_sequence) JOIN nw_group_memory_extraction_policies c USING(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id) WHERE p.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND c.enabled AND s.author_kind='end_user' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_group_bindings g JOIN nw_group_service_agents sa ON (sa.tenant_id,sa.integration_id,sa.group_binding_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id) JOIN nw_agents a ON (a.tenant_id,a.id)=(sa.tenant_id,sa.agent_id) JOIN nw_agent_publications ap ON ap.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ap.agent_id=a.id AND ap.id=a.published_revision_id JOIN nw_integration_business_scopes b ON (b.tenant_id,b.integration_id,b.scope_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.business_scope_id) JOIN nw_tenants t ON t.id=g.tenant_id WHERE (g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id)=(p.tenant_id,p.integration_id,p.group_binding_id) AND g.status='active' AND sa.agent_id=c.extractor_agent_id AND sa.status='active' AND a.status='published' AND b.status='active' AND t.status IN('active','warning') AND ap.snapshot #> '{agent,config,memory,automatic_extraction}'='true'::jsonb) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_group_control_states g WHERE g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.integration_id=p.integration_id AND g.group_binding_id=p.group_binding_id AND g.target_ref='*' AND g.scope='memory_extraction' AND g.paused) ORDER BY p.created_at,p.group_binding_id,p.source_sequence FOR UPDATE OF p SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT g.id FROM nw_group_bindings g JOIN nw_group_memory_extraction_policies c ON (c.tenant_id,c.integration_id,c.group_binding_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id) JOIN nw_group_service_agents s ON (s.tenant_id,s.integration_id,s.group_binding_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id) JOIN nw_agents a ON (a.tenant_id,a.id)=(s.tenant_id,s.agent_id) JOIN nw_agent_publications p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.agent_id=a.id AND p.id=a.published_revision_id JOIN nw_integration_business_scopes b ON (b.tenant_id,b.integration_id,b.scope_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.business_scope_id) JOIN nw_tenants t ON t.id=g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND g.integration_id=#{integration} AND g.id::text=#{group} AND g.status='active' AND s.agent_id::text=#{agent} AND s.status='active' AND a.status='published' AND c.enabled AND b.status='active' AND t.status IN('active','warning') AND p.snapshot #> '{agent,config,memory,automatic_extraction}'='true'::jsonb FOR SHARE OF g,c,s,a,b,t ) qualification)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs(tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version, memory_type,canonical_fact_key,agent_id,end_user_id,source_session_id,source_target_kind,source_target_id, source_event_type,integration_id,group_binding_id) VALUES(#{source.tenantId},#{event},#{extractor},#{policy},'group-hydrate','source',#{source.agentId}, #{source.authorEndUserId},#{source.sessionId},'GROUP',#{source.groupBindingId},'group.memory.source', #{source.integrationId},CAST(#{source.groupBindingId} AS bigint)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
